dedupe_keys.name: ribuild lca lcc simulation tool using a probabilistic approach

description: RIBuild publishes software for probabilistic life-cycle assessment and life-cycle costing, developed for project Tasks 5.2 and 5.3 and intended for expert users. The native inventory includes a software ZIP, material, energy-source, insulation-system and case-study CSV descriptors, an overview spreadsheet and a specific tool-licence document. These are one analysis package for evaluating building-insulation options. Zenodo provides free open access and labels the deposit CC BY-ND 3.0; the description also warns that the enclosed tool-specific licence applies, and its text was not inspected. Coverage comprises RIBuild cases without a complete site or time list stated here. Related RIBuild energy and LCA/LCC data contain study inputs and outputs. A limitation is that probability distributions, calculation boundaries and validation evidence are not established in the description. No software, CSV value or licence-document body was downloaded.
